title.from: Lock request notes
Date and time the note was created
This indicator shows if the note is viewable by the loan officer
Date and time the note was modified
This is the note that was attached to the lock record based on the id requested
This is the username of the user who created the note. A complete list of users can be found using the Retrieve users endpoint.
Determines whether the note is visible to the user. Defaults to false. If the note is created by a loan officer, this should be set to true.
The text of the note to attach to the lock record.  Can include instructions, comments, or updates relevant to the lock request.
The username of the user creating the note.  Must correspond to an existing user in the system.  Usernames can be found via the Retrieve user endpoint.
